persons.name: Bhuvanānanda
persons.evidence: mahābuddhayā paṃḍitaśrībhuvanānandana okulībahilisa conahma1 viyājula || thva pustaka dayakā

purpose: parivāracchiyāṃ saptavṛdhiṃ pūrṇṇa juya māla (for the fulfillment of sevenfold prosperity of the family through making and reciting this book)
notes: The recipient of the book is referred to only as 'the resident of Okulībahī' (okulībahilisa conahma).
